fields.summary_ko.0: Texas Instruments (TXN) rose 91.2% over one year through November 10, 2026, significantly outpacing the S&P 500's 11.4% gain, with fiscal Q3 2026 operating margin expanding from 36.9% to 47.6% driven by data center demand.
fields.summary_ko.1: EPS increased 41% (annual $5.47→$7.71) but lagged stock price growth, lifting PER from 33.1x to 36.0x, with current stock price trading at 38.6x 12-month earnings.
fields.summary_ko.2: 12-month operating income through September 2026 was $8.54 billion, still below $10.7 billion in September 2022, with Sales/Price ratio at 12.3x versus 7.0x in 2022.
